metadata.description: Personal Claude Code toolkit: secret protection, context and usage forecast, pipeline control panel, deploy status, Cowork handoff and a skill learner.

plugins.name: control-center
plugins.description: The Claude Code Control Center: one pane over every skill, plugin, workflow and system module, with live status and one-click runs through Claude Code's own commands.

plugins.name: secret-shield
plugins.description: Swaps passwords, keys and database URLs in your messages for named placeholders before Claude sees them, stores the values outside your projects, and reveals them on hover.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, shown in the band above the prompt.

plugins.name: control-panel
plugins.description: A pane with the work pipeline (Brief, Plan, Build, Review, Ship, Report) as one-click buttons, and a search over every skill and command.

plugins.name: deploy-status
plugins.description: Shows the project's latest Vercel production and preview deployments in the status line, read from GitHub; /deploy-status lists them with links.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Picks up the plan Cowork hands over in .claude/handoff.md: announces it when a session opens and gives it to Claude with the first message.

plugins.name: learner
plugins.description: Finds tasks you keep asking Claude for and proposes a skill for each, plus lessons from one project worth sharing with all; nothing is added without your approval.

plugins.name: nudges
plugins.description: Suggests the right command at the right moment above the prompt, with a one-click Run: ship-check after a commit or push, next-part on a clean project, finishing old uncommitted work, and the manager update on Friday afternoons.
